title: [PC, Steam] Detroit: Become Human $10.79 (82% off) @ Fanatical
body:
Deal: [PC, Steam] Detroit: Become Human $10.79 (82% off) @ Fanatical

[jaimex2] Playing this at the moment, it is a very good game.
Doing me second play-through now.
[scottb721] "Forgetting who you are, to become what someone needs you to be" What a scene!
[Grale] Playing as well and so impressed with the quality of the game!
Can't get enough of it!
At the rate we're going, this might actually be the reality given the timeline!
[regxxz2] not against the op, price often goes down to $5.99 https://steamdb.info/app/1222140/
[freefall101] Yes, that the site is called SteamDB and says Steam price history is a clue.
[Quantum Quokka] In which case.. . it was $2.87 once.. . in Kazakhstan
[OZKap] @Quantum Quokka: In australia it was au$5.99 on three separate occasions in 2026 so far.
[Blitzfx] @OZKap: Rather use itad
https://isthereanydeal.com/game/detroit-become-human/history…
[CrispyChrispy] @Blitzfx: Rather use https://gg.deals/ as it also shows 3rd party marketplace prices as well.
[nategasm] @Blitzfx: Still historically cheaper on Steam
$5.99 - December 18th - Jan 5th (Winter Sale)
$5.99 - March 19th - March 26th (Spring Sale)
$5.99 - June 25th - July 9th (Summer Sale)
Going by this pattern, it will likely be $5.99 again at the Autumn sale which is only 18 days away .
[Blitzfx] @nategasm: Historically cheaper on Gamesplanet $5.09. Factoring in todays exchange rate, $5.44.
[CrispyChrispy] It's a ~$1.50 AUD cheaper off Gamebillet and a few other official sites…
This isn't that special of a price
[prkr] It’s such a great game. Disappointed it’s over. Enjoyed it so much- such a fantastic storyline and so so engaging.
[Vavoom] Excellent game worth a replay when you finish it once but it is definitely not like Witcher 3 or KCD2.
